metadata.description: 画风DNA生产库 - v5.4，画风×内容解耦验证通过：dna统一为中性技法层（怎么画），content_theme承载可交换题材层（画什么），支持跨题材复用。37种画风（含IP命名试点）。v5.4 以《十日终焉》现代密封都「空屋」场景全量37款实测，32款场景保持现代当代（解耦成功），5款深耦合画风原生题材牵引属预期（技法本质与题材强绑定）。
metadata.format: dna + constraint + recommended_composition + recommended_lighting, 每条DNA≤800字符，指令性写法
metadata.prompt_structure: 6段式: [质量触发词] + Art style: [dna] [constraint] + [构图策略] + [光影叙事] + [场景] + [人物≤100字]
metadata.quality_trigger: IMG_2094.CR2, 8K ultra HD, cinematic quality, masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed
metadata.optimized_for: Seedream 5.0 Pro, 纯文生图, 3:4竖版, 英文提示词
metadata.curation_note: v5.1试点：以IP命名画风。新增「双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）」独立条目，从IP参考图重建DNA（手绘糙边+色块内部渐变+主观色彩分区+2D/3D混合），与「现代电影感美漫」(Marvel系)并存。v5.0清洗：汰换7个传统媒介/低还原画风(伊藤潤二/维多利亚版画/浮世绘/国风水墨/凡妮塔斯/吉卜力/圣魔之血)，合并3组重复(赛博三合一/黑执事+圣魔之血/港漫+硬朗武侠)，新增10个已验证画风(4美漫+6全生态)。筛选原则：Seedream保真档位优先，淘汰模拟物理媒介，鼓励数字媒介全视觉生态

tested_phases.Phase 0: 提示词结构验证 → 结构A(4段式·画风优先)为最优解
tested_phases.Phase 3: 3条优化验证(极简人物/质量触发词/DNA精简)
tested_phases.Phase 4: 8种强辨识度画风验证，全部成功
tested_phases.Phase 5: 36种画风全量验证，0失败，辨识度评估完成
tested_phases.Phase 6: 6段式提示词升级测试，5风格×2构图=10张，新海诚达Pinterest级A档，凡妮塔斯D档失败(水彩被暗色吞噬)
tested_phases.Phase 7: LT2柔光通透/LT3平光漫射验证，8张全成功。凡妮塔斯D→B拯救成功，浮世绘/水墨LT3保护成功B+，轻小说A档
tested_phases.Phase 8: 全视觉生态扩容验证：美漫4风格(极简线稿93.3%/电影感92%/经典漫威8/10/概念艺术78) + 全生态6风格(波普90/低多边形92/电影海报87/超现实8.7/扁平矢量4.35/极简线条84.1)，10/10全成功

key_learnings: 极简人物描述(100字)显著释放画风表达空间
质量触发词(IMG_2094.CR2)稳定提升材质和光影35-50%
画风DNA精简到≤800字符+指令性写法有效提升风格执行力
结构A(画风优先)符合Seedream注意力权重分配机制
6段式提示词结构(加入构图+光影维度)显著提升审美品质，新海诚风格达到Pinterest级A档
剪影悬念构图在缩略图辨识度上普遍优于尺度操控，更适合Pinterest传播
减法照明(LT1)与暗色风格天然兼容，但会吞噬水彩/柔美风格(凡妮塔斯D档失败)
风格与光影的兼容性是关键变量，需为柔美风格使用LT2柔光通透模板
并发出图(5线程)将10张测试从30分钟压缩到4分钟，效率提升7.5倍
LT2柔光通透成功拯救水彩风格：凡妮塔斯从D档提升到B档，水彩质感(透明晕染/色彩渗透)存活
LT3平光漫射成功保护平面/传统媒介风格：浮世绘B+(色块+粗线存活)，水墨B+(笔墨晕染+留白存活)
轻小说插画风+LT2获得A档，柔光通透与理想化角色设计天然适配
吉卜力风格+LT2仅C+，问题不在光影而在场景——暗黑哥特场景与吉卜力温暖田园气质冲突
光影模板与风格的兼容性矩阵验证完成：LT1(暗黑系)/LT2(柔美系)/LT3(平面系)三分法有效
画风收集突破漫画圈：Seedream还原度取决于媒介(数字vs传统)而非题材(漫画/概念/滤镜)。数字媒介全生态画风(矢量/3D/图形设计)高保真还原，传统物理媒介(水墨/线刻/铜版)被抹平
美漫风格验证：极简线稿93.3%(Sin City/Hellboy级)、电影感美漫92%、经典漫威8/10，数字印刷感(网点/硬边/限制色板)是美漫在Seedream还原的关键
全生态画风验证：波普90/低多边形92/电影海报87/超现实8.7/扁平矢量4.35/极简线条84.1，全部通过，证明AI时代漫画画风可来自全视觉生态
v5.2 画风×内容解耦：dna 统一为中性技法层（怎么画），content_theme 承载可交换题材层（画什么），支持跨题材复用
v5.3 补充净化：不同画风耦合方式各异，逐条审计——新国潮残传统纹样/硬朗武侠残荒漠场景/日系热血残招数斗气等题材词已从技法层剔净；深耦合画风（蒸汽朋克/玄幻/超现实/新艺术）技法本质与题材强绑定，content_theme 保留原生题材锚点，跨题材时由用户决定是否接受

v5.4 全量解耦实测：《十日终焉》现代密封都「空屋」场景统一画面（钨丝灯·斑驳圆桌·座钟·现代着装沉睡者·山羊面具西装男）36款画风全量逐张出图+逐张审图。32款场景保持现代当代（画风技法正常生效、未把场景拉回原生题材，内容解耦成功）；5款深耦合画风（轻小说插画/天野喜孝幻想/蒸汽朋克黄铜/穆夏新艺术/超现实梦境）技法本质即题材，原生牵引属预期（content_theme 保留原生锚点，跨题材时由用户场景覆盖）。关键结论：原污染的「国漫玄幻厚涂 修仙流」已剔净，现代场景不再被拉回古装仙侠；审图时注意故事自带符号（如山羊面具西装男）属场景内容而非污染，勿误判

decoupling_validation.test: 《十日终焉》现代密封都「空屋」统一场景，37款画风全量出图+逐张审图（2026-08-09）
decoupling_validation.scene: 钨丝灯·斑驳圆桌·座钟·十个现代着装沉睡者·山羊面具西装男
decoupling_validation.verdict_criteria: 场景是否保持现代当代（未被拉回该画风原生题材）；技法（线稿/上色/光影/比例）是否保真体现
decoupling_validation.passed_decoupling: 32款：黑执事/赛博边缘行者/日系赛璐珞/日系热血战斗/轻喜剧Q版/少女水彩言情/新海诚电影风/京都动画萌系/大友克洋硬核/90年代复古动漫/伪厚涂半厚涂/国漫玄幻厚涂/硬朗武侠历史/暗黑悬疑高对比/新国潮风/韩漫暗黑厚涂/韩漫华丽言情/韩国Webtoon现代风/哥特暗黑风/迪士尼皮克斯3D/暗黑奇幻油画/废土末日/经典漫威美漫/现代电影感美漫/双城之战/美漫极简线稿/好莱坞概念艺术/电影院线海报/扁平矢量插画/波普艺术/低多边形3D/极简线条插画
decoupling_validation.deep_coupled_expected: 5款（技法本质即题材，原生牵引属预期，content_theme保留原生锚点，跨题材时由用户场景覆盖决定）：轻小说插画风/天野喜孝幻想/蒸汽朋克黄铜/穆夏新艺术/超现实梦境
decoupling_validation.note: 审图注意：故事自带符号（山羊面具西装男/空屋破败）属场景内容而非画风污染，判定污染以'场景时代是否被拉离现代当代'为准；美漫/波普/极简/3D等风格化技法会改变画面观感但场景时代不变，属技法生效非内容污染

黑执事.name: 黑执事
黑执事.dna: Art style by Yana Toboso from Black Butler manga. Clean precise linework with bold contrast, sharp angular lines for dramatic effect. Thick confident outlines for characters, geometric precision in architectural elements. Rich deep color palette: black, crimson, gold, deep purple. Saturated jewel tones with flat cel-shading. Pale skin with cool undertones, metallic sheen on gold and brass. Dramatic chiaroscuro with strong contrast, theatrical spotlight illumination, candlelit warm golden glow. Deep black shadows with no detail, rim lighting on figures against dark backgrounds. 7 head proportion, sharp angular features, narrow intense eyes, upright refined posture.
黑执事.constraint: Must maintain clean precise linework and cel-shaded coloring. No watercolor. No soft painterly blending. No photorealistic. No cartoonish. Keep sharp contrast. No text overlay.
黑执事.content_theme: Dark Victorian gothic setting with aristocratic characters, candlelit manor interiors, operatic drama, refined horror atmosphere. Native genre: dark gothic/Victorian.

赛博边缘行者.name: 赛博边缘行者
赛博边缘行者.dna: Art style by Studio Trigger, Hiroyuki Imaishi direction. Bold thick outlines with deliberate irregularity, dynamic energetic linework. Lines vary in thickness for speed and impact, sharp angular strokes for mechanical elements. High saturation fluorescent palette: neon pink, electric blue, acid green, warning yellow. Deep blacks and dark purples, flat cel-shading with sharp boundaries. Glowing effects, extreme high contrast lighting. Neon glow from below and sides, deep shadows with colored rim lights. 6.5 head proportion, dynamic exaggerated, sharp angular faces, expressive eyes.
赛博边缘行者.constraint: Must maintain bold outlines and cel-shaded coloring. High saturation neon colors. No watercolor. No soft pastel. No painterly blending. No realistic proportions. Keep dynamic anime style. No text overlay.
赛博边缘行者.content_theme: Cyberpunk dystopian urban setting with high-tech low-life, cybernetic enhancements, neon-lit streets, speed violence and rebellion. Native genre: cyberpunk/sci-fi.

日系赛璐珞.name: 日系赛璐珞
日系赛璐珞.dna: Clean cel-shading Japanese anime style, bold visible outline strokes, flat color fills with no soft blending. Clean precise linework with consistent bold outlines, closed line art with no gaps. Clear separation between subject and background, geometric and tidy. Flat color fills with two-tone cel shading, sharp highlight edges. Vibrant saturated palette with bright primary colors, flat skin tones with simple blush marks. High contrast between base color and shadow color, no gradient transitions. Simple two-tone lighting: base light and cel shadow, harsh but clean shadow boundaries. Sharp white specular highlights, no atmospheric or ambient lighting effects. 7 head proportion, large expressive eyes, small nose and mouth, youthful cute features.
日系赛璐珞.constraint: Must maintain bold visible outline strokes and flat color fills. No soft gradient blending. No photorealistic. No cinematic concept art. No 3D rendering. No text overlay.
日系赛璐珞.content_theme: Everyday contemporary Japanese anime subjects with youthful characters in school and urban slice-of-life settings. Native genre: anime/slice-of-life.

日系热血战斗.name: 日系热血战斗
日系热血战斗.dna: Modern Japanese shonen manga style, dynamic action. Bold outlines with varying thickness, thick for impact, fine for quiet scenes. Speed lines and action lines, screen tone patterns for texture. Vibrant saturated colors: bright blues, fiery oranges, crisp whites. Flat cel-shading with sharp contrast, bold color blocking. High contrast action lighting, dramatic spotlights, bold glowing effects. Motion blur and impact flashes, bold white highlights against dark backgrounds. 6.5-7 head proportion, large expressive eyes, exaggerated expressions, dynamic foreshortening.
日系热血战斗.constraint: Must maintain bold outlines and cel-shaded coloring. Vibrant saturated colors. Screen tone texture. No painterly style. No watercolor. No photorealistic. Keep dynamic shonen manga aesthetic. No text overlay.
日系热血战斗.content_theme: High-stakes battle and adventure subjects with young heroes, rivalries, friendship, arena duels and climactic fights. Native genre: shonen battle/adventure.

轻喜剧Q版.name: 轻喜剧Q版
轻喜剧Q版.dna: Cute slice-of-life manga style, soft wholesome aesthetic. Soft rounded linework with consistent gentle thickness, no sharp angles, everything curved. Simple clean lines, minimal detail, cute chibi-style exaggeration. Bright warm pastel palette: soft pink, mint green, butter yellow, baby blue. Flat cel-shading with soft edges, clean bright colors, no dark tones, gentle gradient overlays. Bright even lighting, no harsh shadows, soft warm natural light, sunny and cheerful. 4-5 head proportion, large round eyes, small noses and mouths, big heads, short limbs, round bodies.
轻喜剧Q版.constraint: Must maintain soft rounded linework and bright pastel palette. No sharp angles. No realistic proportions. Keep cute and wholesome. No text overlay.
轻喜剧Q版.content_theme: Wholesome everyday comedy subjects with cute children and families, gentle humor, cozy daily life and found-family moments. Native genre: slice-of-life/comedy.

少女水彩言情.name: 少女水彩言情
少女水彩言情.dna: Shoujo watercolor manga style, delicate soft lineart with watercolor wash coloring and bleeding edges. Fine thin strokes, soft edges blending into coloring, graceful flowing lines. Watercolor wash with bleeding edges, soft pastel macaron palette: pink, lavender, baby blue, mint. Semi-transparent layers with visible wash texture, soft gradient transitions. Soft dreamy glow, no harsh shadows. Backlighting with ethereal halos, warm golden hour light, bokeh effects. 7 head proportion, large teary eyes with sparkling highlights, petite slender figures.
少女水彩言情.constraint: Must maintain delicate soft lineart and watercolor wash coloring. Keep pastel macaron palette. No thick oil texture. No realistic proportions. No harsh contrast. No text overlay.
少女水彩言情.phase7_note: 马卡龙色板出色，水彩模拟良好
少女水彩言情.content_theme: Tender romance subjects with petite heroines, flowers and sparkle decorations, fairy-tale dreamy atmosphere, pure innocent love. Native genre: shoujo romance.

新海诚电影风.name: 新海诚电影风
新海诚电影风.keywords: 光影极致·通透梦幻·壁纸级
新海诚电影风.dna: Makoto Shinkai cinematic anime style. Breathtaking luminous lighting with dreamlike color gradients. Crystal-clear transparent skies with volumetric cloud rendering. Rich saturated colors: deep oranges, purples, and blues blending seamlessly. Light refraction and lens flare effects, god rays through clouds. Hyper-detailed backgrounds with photographic precision. Delicate cel-shading with soft gradient transitions on characters. Signature Shinkai blue sky, pink-purple-orange sunset gradients. Digital compositing precision, clean polished frames, no hand-drawn roughness.
新海诚电影风.constraint: Must maintain Shinkai cinematic quality with luminous lighting and transparent colors. No gritty textures. No flat 2D coloring. Keep dreamlike atmosphere. No text overlay.
新海诚电影风.content_theme: Poignant emotional subjects involving city streets, trains, weather and sky, themes of distance, longing and poetic melancholy. Native genre: cinematic romance/drama.

京都动画萌系.name: 京都动画萌系
京都动画萌系.keywords: 京阿尼脸·细腻日常·柔光
京都动画萌系.dna: Kyoto Animation studio style, KyoAni aesthetic. Signature KyoAni face design: round faces, large eyes with rich multi-layered highlights, detailed irises. Extremely detailed and silky hair rendering with individual strand highlights. Soft and transparent lighting with gentle warmth, filter-like glow effect. Shallow depth of field, bokeh backgrounds like DSLR photography. Clean polished digital linework, consistent quality, smooth and fluid. Realistic backgrounds with careful rendering. 7.5 head proportion, idealized but natural, graceful posture.
京都动画萌系.constraint: Must maintain KyoAni signature face design and silky hair rendering. No gritty textures. No flat cel-shading without highlights. Keep warm transparent lighting. No text overlay.
京都动画萌系.content_theme: Gentle everyday subjects with high school students, detailed daily-life props, warm quiet beauty in ordinary moments. Native genre: slice-of-life/healing.

大友克洋硬核.name: 大友克洋硬核
大友克洋硬核.dna: Katsuhiro Otomo AKIRA style, hard-core manga aesthetic. Rough powerful linework with bold strokes, distinctive gritty and aggressive line quality. Exaggerated perspective and foreshortening, extreme camera angles. Meticulously detailed mechanical rendering. Dynamic motion blur and speed effects, sense of unstoppable force. High contrast coloring with industrial palette: steel gray, rust orange, neon accents. Film grain texture overlay, retro analog feel, VHS-like quality. 7.5 head proportion, semi-realistic, strong jawlines, intense expressions.
大友克洋硬核.constraint: Must maintain rough gritty linework and mechanical detail. No soft watercolor. No cute proportions. No clean polished digital look. Keep film grain and high contrast. No text overlay.
大友克洋硬核.content_theme: Hardcore sci-fi and cyberpunk subjects with motorcycles, cybernetic parts, futuristic equipment, urban decay and apocalyptic tension. Native genre: cyberpunk/sci-fi.

轻小说插画风.name: 轻小说插画风
轻小说插画风.dna: Japanese light novel cover illustration style. Clean refined linework with elegant curves, moderate line weight. Soft luminous coloring with airy gradients, semi-transparent layered shading. Beautiful and idealized character design, attractive and appealing. Soft bokeh backgrounds slightly out of focus, drawing attention to character. Dreamy lighting with gentle glow effects, sparkles and light particles. Warm pastel-leaning palette with vivid accent colors for hair and eyes. Detailed costume and accessory design, flowing fabric and ornamental details. 8 head proportion, elongated elegant, large sparkling eyes with intricate iris detail.
轻小说插画风.constraint: Must maintain soft luminous quality and idealized beauty. No photorealistic. No gritty texture. No flat cel-shading. Keep dreamy atmospheric lighting. No text overlay.
轻小说插画风.phase7_note: 柔光与理想化角色设计天然适配，A档
轻小说插画风.content_theme: Aspirational romantic and fantastical subjects with idealized characters, ornate costumes and accessories, quiet emotional undertone. Native genre: light novel/fantasy.

90年代复古动漫.name: 90年代复古动漫
90年代复古动漫.dna: 1990s retro anime style, classic cel animation aesthetic. Traditional cel-painted look with visible paint texture, slight color misalignment between line and paint. Bold but slightly rough outlines, hand-drawn imperfection, organic wobble. Limited color palette typical of 90s anime production, slightly faded and desaturated. VHS video tape aesthetic: subtle noise, slight color bleeding, mild scan lines. Film grain and occasional dust scratches, warm analog color cast. Soft and slightly washed-out highlights, no modern digital crispness. Classic anime proportions: 6.5-7 head, large eyes, simple shading.
90年代复古动漫.constraint: Must maintain 90s cel animation and VHS aesthetic. No modern digital crispness. No photorealistic 3D. No ultra-high definition sharpness. Keep retro analog warmth and imperfection. No text overlay.
90年代复古动漫.content_theme: Nostalgic warm animation subjects evoking the golden age of anime, sunset and dusk scenes with optical lens flare. Native genre: retro anime/nostalgia.

天野喜孝幻想.name: 天野喜孝幻想
天野喜孝幻想.dna: Yoshitaka Amano illustration style, ethereal fantasy aesthetic. Delicate wispy linework with ethereal quality, lines seem to float and dissolve. Watercolor and ink mixed media, translucent layered colors with visible paper texture. Muted and sophisticated palette: dusty rose, teal, gold, ivory, lavender. Colors blend and bleed organically, no hard edges. Elongated androgynous figures, 9+ head proportion, impossibly elegant. Fine detailed hair flowing like water, delicate hands and long fingers. Decorative and ornamental, influenced by Art Nouveau and ukiyo-e.
天野喜孝幻想.constraint: Must maintain Amano's ethereal wispy linework and watercolor-ink blend. No photorealistic. No bold thick outlines. No modern anime cel-shading. No digital crispness. Keep dreamlike otherworldly quality. No text overlay.
天野喜孝幻想.content_theme: Mythic and poetic subjects with ethereal figures existing between realms, spiritual and transcendent atmosphere. Native genre: fantasy/mythic.

伪厚涂半厚涂.name: 伪厚涂半厚涂
伪厚涂半厚涂.dna: Semi-thick painting manga style, clean hard outer contour lines with soft gradient shading inside. Visible but not overwhelming outlines, moderate line weight for structure. Cel-shaded base with painterly soft-light overlays, soft gradient inside color blocks. Rich midtones with subtle color variation, warm skin tones with natural undertones. Soft directional lighting with gentle gradients, multiple light sources with temperature shifts. Warm ambient light with cool shadow tones, rim light for depth. 7.5 head proportion, semi-realistic, balanced features, natural anatomy with slight idealization. Modern refined illustration quality, professional commercial manga look, premium webtoon quality.
伪厚涂半厚涂.constraint: Maintain visible outer contour lines and soft gradient shading inside color blocks. No lineless style. No cinematic concept art. No photorealistic 3D rendering. Keep manga readability. No text overlay.
伪厚涂半厚涂.content_theme: Modern premium commercial manga and webtoon subjects, versatile across genres. Native genre: general/commercial.

国漫玄幻厚涂.name: 国漫玄幻厚涂
国漫玄幻厚涂.dna: Chinese painterly manga style, brush-like variable-width lineart with calligraphic quality. Thick bold strokes for main forms, thin delicate lines for details, natural taper from brush pressure. Rich warm palette with saturated accents: cinnabar red, gold, jade green, deep blue. Gradient shading with luminous highlights, saturated color accents. Dramatic single-source lighting, lens flare and light beams, rim light on characters, atmospheric haze. 7.5 head proportion, elegant refined features.
国漫玄幻厚涂.constraint: Maintain brush-like variable-width lineart and gradient shading. Use high-saturation saturated color accents. Keep dramatic lighting and rim light. No flat cel-shading. No text overlay.
国漫玄幻厚涂.content_theme: Chinese 修仙流 painterly manga style with decorative swirl patterns on costumes, dense Eastern ornamental patterns, glowing magic effects with particle layers, metal and jade material textures, warm golden cultivation energy, cool spiritual artifacts, flowing hair and costume silhouettes. Native genre: 修仙流/cultivation.

硬朗武侠历史.name: 硬朗武侠历史
硬朗武侠历史.dna: Gritty bold carved manga style, rough carved lineart with bold powerful strokes. Deliberately uneven aggressive line quality, thick dark contours, minimal detail, maximum impact. Carved scratched quality with ink splash and bleed effects. Low-saturation earthy palette: ochre, burnt sienna, rust red, charcoal gray. Rough texture on all surfaces, weathered aged quality, blood red as accent. High-contrast hard lighting from intense single sources, deep crushed black shadows. No soft gradients, rim light from intense single sources. Realistic 8 head proportions, rugged weathered features.
硬朗武侠历史.constraint: Maintain rough carved bold lineart and low-saturation earthy palette. Keep high-contrast hard lighting. No soft pretty anime style. No bright saturated colors. No text overlay.
硬朗武侠历史.content_theme: Historical wuxia subjects on Ancient China's harsh frontier, gritty survival, conflict and the weight of history. Native genre: wuxia/historical.

CT1_scale_contrast.name: 尺度操控
CT1_scale_contrast.desc: Composition: Vast environment dominates the frame, character is small in the lower third as a scale reference. Negative space above with atmospheric texture and depth. Character faces away from viewer, looking toward the distant horizon. Extreme wide shot, environment as primary subject, figure as narrative anchor.
CT1_scale_contrast.best_for: 史诗/电影感风格，环境叙事为主的场景

CT2_silhouette_back.name: 剪影悬念
CT2_silhouette_back.desc: Composition: Character shown from behind in three-quarter back view, face partially obscured by shadow and hair. Tight cropping on upper body. Mystery through concealment. Single light source from front creating dramatic backlit silhouette. Rim lighting on shoulders and hair edges. Figure as viewing proxy, audience sees what character sees.
CT2_silhouette_back.best_for: 神秘/氛围感风格，角色代入感强的场景

LT1_subtractive.name: 减法照明
LT1_subtractive.desc: Lighting: Subtractive lighting, 80% of image in deep atmospheric shadow. Only key features selectively illuminated. Edge rim lighting on silhouette. Darkness as active narrative presence, not absence. Multi-layer fog and atmospheric haze creating depth. Cold dominant palette with single warm focal point ≤10% of frame.
LT1_subtractive.best_for: 暗黑/哥特/恐怖/赛博风格，与暗色场景天然兼容
LT1_subtractive.warning: 会吞噬水彩/柔美风格，此类风格应改用LT2柔光通透模板

LT2_soft_luminous.name: 柔光通透
LT2_soft_luminous.desc: Lighting: Soft luminous lighting with gentle diffused glow. Light emanates from within the image, characters remain visible and readable. Warm ambient light with cool shadow undertones. Backlighting with ethereal halos, golden hour quality. Bokeh and light particles. No crushed blacks, shadows retain color information. Luminous shadows, preserving figure readability even in dark scenes.
LT2_soft_luminous.best_for: 水彩/柔美/治愈/明亮风格，保护柔美画风不被暗色场景吞噬
LT2_soft_luminous.warning: 不适用于纯暗黑风格，会削弱黑暗氛围
LT2_soft_luminous.note: v4.0新增模板，Phase 7验证通过：成功拯救水彩风格(D→B)，轻小说插画风获A档

LT3_flat_atmospheric.name: 平光漫射
LT3_flat_atmospheric.desc: Lighting: Flat even illumination with minimal directional lighting. Light distributed uniformly across the scene, no dramatic shadows. Atmospheric depth through color and mist rather than light/shadow contrast. Subtle ambient occlusion only. Medium-key lighting, neither high nor low contrast. Natural diffuse light like overcast sky or soft window light. Texture and line quality are primary visual carriers, not lighting drama.
LT3_flat_atmospheric.best_for: 平面/矢量/图形风格，光影不应抢夺线条和色块的表达权
LT3_flat_atmospheric.warning: 不适用于需要光影戏剧性的风格
LT3_flat_atmospheric.note: v4.0新增模板，Phase 7验证通过：保护平面画风线条与色块表达
